text:
rachel: Quick check - auditor Mark wants evidence of our vulnerability triage correlation to RBAC changes for Q1 2025. Specifically: link vuln tickets to any role modifications that were performed as part of remediation.

dave: We can join vuln tickets to role_change events by looking for automation comments or change_request ids in the ticket.

teri: Auditor Mark also asked for a spreadsheet mapping each vuln -> remediation date -> role change event id (if any) -> patch/cfg change PR url. He wants CSV plus sample exported PDFs of ticket timelines.

auditor_mark: Yes please include severity, CVE, detection date, triage owner, remediation date, and evidence that the role change removed privileged access. Also include any post-remediation access re-check logs.

rachel: Proposed steps: 1) query Jira for tickets with labels `vuln-remediation` between 2025-01-01 and 2025-03-31; 2) for each ticket, search for `change_request_id` or `role_change_event` markers in comments; 3) if found, extract the event id and include the kafka offset and partition; 4) capture a 24-hour post-remediation access-check from auth-service that queries active sessions for the affected role.

dave: We'll produce `vuln_rbac_map.csv` with headers: ticket_id, cve, severity, detected_at, triage_owner, remediation_at, role_change_event_id, role_change_kafka_offset, pr_url, post_remediation_check_link.

teri: Redaction: replace user email with handle and redact full IPs. We'll include sanitized PR URLs (repo path + hash but no tokens).

rachel: We'll also include a small narrative in `readme.md` explaining how the correlation was performed and limitations (e.g., automated role changes from remediation runbooks may not always create explicit change_request ids).

auditor_mark: Good. For the post-remediation access check, provide the exact commands and the query snapshot (JSON) showing zero active sessions for the removed role after remediation window.

dave: We'll add `post_remediation_checks.json` and include offsets/time ranges. Also will add checksums and sign the final bundle with KMS per standard process.

evidence-bot: Created evidence ticket EVID-20250320-01 and stored interim artifacts in s3://redwood-evidence/evid-20250320-01/ (expires in 14d).

rachel: Thanks team. I'll assemble CSV + PDFs + post-check JSON and run the signing flow. Will tag auditor when ready.
